$comment: Lighthouse CI budgets — Lookauramax Website Round 2 (Decision 5 A1 governance + Decision 6 S1: field CWV gated by Lighthouse CI). Enforced by tools/run-lighthouse.mjs.

notes.INP: INP (Interaction to Next Paint) is a FIELD metric — it requires real user input on real devices and CANNOT be measured in a lab run. The lab gate therefore uses Total Blocking Time (TBT <= 200 ms) as its proxy: long tasks are what make interactions slow, so a page that keeps TBT under budget is a page whose INP has the room to pass in the field. Field INP itself is watched via RUM / CrUX segmented by device class (Z.ai §10.1), not by this script.
notes.performanceScore: Reported for visibility, deliberately NOT gated: the score is a weighted blend that can dip for reasons outside the three budgets; the budgets are the contract.
notes.scope: Mobile form factor, Lighthouse default (applied) throttling — the audience is mid-range Android first (Decision 6 / Z.ai §10.1).
notes.thresholdsSource: LCP <= 2500 ms and CLS <= 0.1 are Google's 'good' Core Web Vitals thresholds. TBT <= 200 ms is Lighthouse's 'good' TBT band and the standard lab stand-in for the 200 ms INP 'good' threshold.
